text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council approval to extend the existing short-term parking on Scarsdale Road, in front of Metamorphosis Greek Orthodox School, further north to be in front of La Citadelle Academy. The proposed short-term parking in front of La Citadelle Academy was part of the site plan application for the school. The proposed parking amendments will result in 12 on-street parking spaces for student pick-up/drop-off activity in front of La Citadelle Academy.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing 10 minute maximum parking limit, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Scarsdale Road, between Preakness Drive and a point 65 metres north. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Scarsdale Road, between Preakness Drive and a point 140 metres north.
